generation.scope: Exclude every exceptional line fiber in surface-free regular windows of opposite rank six or seven. At seven, opposite binary kernels would pair each forward center to a backward center by a conic of pure relations. The ensuing twisted cubic has a successor simultaneously contained in a plane and a quadric cone, contradicting the reversed degree. This covers all regular windows through opposite rank seven. A pure-free branching window must have opposite rank at least nine and a full L3 pencil.

open_mathematics: Address branching at rank eight with pure relations, higher-rank one-sided centers, finite point graphs without the established marks and global component and period data.
